gameplayPillars.description: Play 17 same-system attractions and six Game Room attractions, with larger groups supported online or through local wireless.

gameplayPillars.title: Switch 2 enhancements
gameplayPillars.description: Enjoy up to 4K resolution on compatible TVs, 1080p handheld presentation, smoother performance and faster loading.

gameplayPillars.title: Expanded cast and co-op
gameplayPillars.description: Rosalina joins the playable cast, while Co-Star Luma can assist another player and supports mouse controls.

worldSummary: The original Flower Kingdom returns with all of its six worlds and Petal Isles, while Bellabel Park adds a dedicated multiplayer hub filled with competitive and cooperative attractions, Toad Brigade training and new Koopalings encounters.

faq.q: Is this a separate Switch 2 Edition?
faq.a: Yes. It is an official Nintendo Switch 2 Edition containing the original game plus the upgrade content.
Bellabel Park, larger multiplayer options, Rosalina, Co-Star Luma, Koopalings content, mouse-control support, Assist Mode and visual/loading improvements.

faq.q: What is the maximum online player count?
faq.a: Bellabel Park Game Room attractions can support up to 12 players online.

verdictSummary: The most complete version of an already outstanding 2D Mario game. Bellabel Park expands its social side while the higher-resolution presentation is a meaningful Switch 2 upgrade.
verdictPros: Includes the full acclaimed Wonder campaign
verdictCons: Upgrade value depends on interest in multiplayer

reviews.quote: Nintendo positions it as the definitive Switch 2 version with new content.
The included original campaign received universal acclaim.
Reviews praised the smoother presentation and Bellabel Park additions.
